<h1 id="h-greetings-locksmiths" class="text-4xl font-header !mt-8 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0">Greetings, Locksmiths!</h1><p>Another month of bustling activity and the Unlock Train continues along the tracks we have laid out for it <span data-name="railway_track" class="emoji" data-type="emoji">🛤</span><span data-name="railway_track" class="emoji" data-type="emoji">🛤</span><span data-name="steam_locomotive" class="emoji" data-type="emoji">🚂</span><span data-name="railway_car" class="emoji" data-type="emoji"><img src="/images/blog/unlock-dao-newsletter---june-2026/1f683.png" draggable="false" loading="lazy" align="absmiddle"></span><span data-name="railway_car" class="emoji" data-type="emoji"><img src="/images/blog/unlock-dao-newsletter---june-2026/1f683.png" draggable="false" loading="lazy" align="absmiddle"></span><span data-name="railway_track" class="emoji" data-type="emoji">🛤</span><span data-name="railway_track" class="emoji" data-type="emoji">🛤</span></p><p>We've got Steward Role renewals, Contributor Spotlights, Finance &amp; Marketing updates, and all kinds of opportunities to contribute. It's always a great time to be engaged, so make sure you check out all the updates in this month's newsletter to get inspired for what you want to contribute next...</p><hr><h1 id="h-governance-summary" class="text-4xl font-header !mt-8 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0">Governance Summary</h1><p><strong><u>Current Active Proposals:</u></strong></p><ul><li><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.tally.xyz/gov/unlock-protocol/proposal/66728080304729327256955815578259394201561279190085123704443957973632110156193">May Collaborator Payments</a></p></li><li><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreumontpascual/">Andreu's</a>  <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.tally.xyz/gov/unlock-protocol/proposal/108202323685789857541913551469023357408498726856068862109710464182586706901438">Steward Renewal for Finances &amp; Resources </a></p></li></ul><p><em>Please cast your votes!</em></p><p>We had a big month in June for governance, with a whole entire proposal getting approved! The <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://governance.unlock-protocol.com/proposals/25181271989655662623024146840827886471765061226284595407103064533818345758853">May Payroll</a> was successfully executed, keeping the Unlock DAO train moving onward. Work is getting accomplished in many different areas; we've got people working on the train engine, we've got people out scouting the tracks for new destinations, and there's a hive of activity in the train cars themselves, promoting and progressing community projects of many flavors!</p><figure float="none" data-type="figure" class="img-center"><img src="/images/blog/unlock-dao-newsletter---june-2026/52d1f1c8ca1896fddf393e80085e902c7ca9c4ab6a51319ee1dace0d3654cc2e.png" blurdataurl="data:image/png;base64," nextheight="1783" nextwidth="2569" class="image-node embed"><figcaption htmlattributes="[object Object]" class="hide-figcaption"></figcaption></figure><p>Every train needs responsible people managing key roles, and that is why Unlock has a core of DAO Stewards to help keep things rolling:</p><ul><li><p>Recently, my poorly formatted proposal was approved for <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://governance.unlock-protocol.com/proposals/114657684322038141531378674436101611169294047010411289952923812717983841996826">Communications Steward</a>. It is my responsibility to keep our weekly DAO calls organized and relevant. I also draft this newsletter every month to help keep everyone informed!</p></li><li><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreumontpascual/">Andreu</a> is refreshing his role as the Steward of Finances. Please review his <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.tally.xyz/gov/unlock-protocol/proposal/108202323685789857541913551469023357408498726856068862109710464182586706901438">proposal</a> and cast your votes!</p></li><li><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/cecilia-contreras-castro/">Ceci</a> has also <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c7lSpNoyjbGq9NQ7sci6H4Gl-XO1lE2vEBFyisyRz0g/edit?usp=sharing">drafted </a>her renewal for Steward of Marketing. Please review it for important info on all that the Marketing Team has accomplished under her expert care! Leave any feedback or questions in the chat.</p></li></ul><ul><li><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/anupadasgupta/">Anupa</a> is drafting a proposal for funding the work she's done with the U-Make-Us program she developed and shipped this year. This has been a fantastic series, so make sure you check our <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4EDTaxNLpu7vblNInb-0BzwlH8o_Go5s">Community Spotlights</a> to see who has been building their communities and projects with Unlock. This is steward-level work that has been volunteered and, as such, deserves serious consideration for compensation &amp; reputation from the DAO if we wish to see the work continue.</p></li></ul><hr><h1 id="h-marketing-progress" class="text-4xl font-header !mt-8 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0">Marketing Progress</h1><h3 id="h-metopia" class="text-2xl font-header !mt-6 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0"><u>Metopia</u></h3><p>The first campaign for <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://metopia.xyz/project/unlock">Metopia </a>has concluded, with an impressive 3,867 users engaging. The program focused on introducing people to Unlock and helping them discover how to use it. Everything always starts with education!</p><p>With this groundwork in place, the second campaign with Metopia will be structured specifically around driving more paid locks. Projects and communities that generate e-commerce and use Unlock to manage their workflows are the lifeblood of the protocol, so this is a crucial next step for Unlock to continue on the track toward a sustainable economy.</p><h3 id="h-incented" class="text-2xl font-header !mt-6 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0"><u>Incented</u></h3><p>An important part of a decentralized organization is drawing from a community of active contributors. This means people generating submissions for the DAO, in the form of usable content. It isn't as simple as just letting anyone post 'official content', however. There has to be structure, guidelines, and accountability to ensure that consensus reflects the entire DAO, not just the arbitrary decisions of a chaotic system.<br><br>Enter <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://incented.co/details/22f3773a-a709-4b84-b0f1-10dc72adbf1e">Incented</a>: a platform built to enable a community to actively participate in making submissions as well as deciding which ones are approved vs denied.<br><br>Officially launched on June 8th, the Incented Campaign offers cold, hard cash (repurposed from the&nbsp;<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://carrotcastle.xyz/">Carrot Castle</a>&nbsp;sponsorship at EthDenver2025) for participants and $UP tokens for voters. Both content contributors and voters are rewarded, so everyone can participate!<br><br>Check out this intro <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://youtu.be/y41_-YEKaQM?si=UgtJp1gchENn2hnt">video</a><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://carrotcastle.xyz/"> </a>from <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/stella-achenbach/">Stella </a>to get informed on how to participate!</p><div data-type="youtube" videoid="y41_-YEKaQM">

It is up to us, the DAO, to make good use of this ecosystem awareness and keep connecting with projects that produce real value for their communities and align with the goals of Unlock.</p><hr><h1 id="h-financial-tracking" class="text-4xl font-header !mt-8 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0">Financial Tracking</h1><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreumontpascual/">Andreu</a> has the next <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rIv_VnPQNsq_wNlnlylQ4CtbtMdH3cNc/edit?usp=sharing&amp;ouid=111129080202509813006&amp;rtpof=true&amp;sd=true">quarterly budget</a> drafted and should move to the proposal stage soon. The current wait is on the Steward role refresher proposals. Once they are nailed down and approved, this proposal will go up for voting as well.</p><p>We also have a new budget-tracking and forecasting report, courtesy of our stalwart Steward of Finances. This resource should help DAO members make more informed decisions about expense proposals and new initiatives to manage &amp; generate revenue. You can download the full PDF <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zGhjDy2pcrsax4jvcdzLBF3a_x0Wwj9t/view?usp=sharing">here</a>.</p><figure float="none" data-type="figure" class="img-center"><img src="/images/blog/unlock-dao-newsletter---june-2026/b00c655be11a51b88c3a69eef1a947462d4878818a226bc208cf85732bf9da5f.png" blurdataurl="data:image/png;base64," nextheight="605" nextwidth="971" class="image-node embed"><figcaption htmlattributes="[object Object]" class="hide-figcaption"></figcaption></figure><p>There is a lot of great data and analysis in the full report, so I highly recommend reviewing it. Here are the strategic recommendations from the report:</p><figure float="none" data-type="figure" class="img-center"><img src="/images/blog/unlock-dao-newsletter---june-2026/d5dff0291ea44bddf15fb27cadb801b0ae59c1fd645b6ba6fb84d0a27ca74ce1.png" blurdataurl="data:image/png;base64," nextheight="592" nextwidth="936" class="image-node embed"><figcaption htmlattributes="[object Object]" class="hide-figcaption"></figcaption></figure><p>These are important considerations for us to take seriously as we continue to push the Unlock Train out of the station: we need enough runway to reach the next destination to avoid getting stranded without access to support! If you have thoughts, insights, or alternative analyses to share about this data, please hit us up on&nbsp;<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://t.me/+HYCVY2wvXbs3Yjhi">Telegram</a>!</p><hr><h1 id="h-technology-updates" class="text-4xl font-header !mt-8 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0">Technology Updates</h1><p>A crucial part of any decentralized protocol is managing the technical contributions of a wide audience of potential contributors. With the advent of AI, automated and semi-automated GitHub commits have become a major source of spam. This further exacerbates the burden of managing contributions as we transition away from a formerly closed team structure.</p><p>As <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/juliengenestoux/">Julien</a> continues to work his way through submissions, we, as a DAO, must strive to help by coordinating and self-organizing in a way that actually reduces this burden, not adds to it. This is no easy task, but if you are one of the many <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://github.com/unlock-protocol">GitHub</a> contributors <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://github.com/unlock-protocol">who</a> have expressed interest in helping us attack our list of <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://github.com/unlock-protocol/unlock/issues">issues </a>and improve our <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://github.com/unlock-protocol/docs">docs</a>, then make sure you head over to <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://t.me/+HYCVY2wvXbs3Yjhi">Telegram</a> and find the "Technical Contributions" topic to share what you are/would like to work on to help make your contributions more visible and easily vetted! Let's get organized! Feel free to tag me directly in the TG group to get more involved.</p><hr><h1 id="h-community-activity" class="text-4xl font-header !mt-8 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0">Community Activity</h1><p>I want to take this time to give a little bit more exposure to <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/anupadasgupta/">Anupa's</a> work on the U-Make-Us series. This showcase event has been fantastic at drawing attention to important projects that are actively using Unlock to help them achieve their community goals. As season 1 comes to a close, now is the time to review this great contribution and consider its value in helping push the goals of the DAO:</p><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.youtube.com/live/dhi-R6SKlRk?si=aLFQA5xMy5itmdzk">Episode 1 - The DAO Stewards</a></p><p>Watch us have a silly old time enjoying each other's company and sharing about what makes Unlock special for us.</p><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.youtube.com/live/LlsZzpQAhwA?si=oGPDwnNj5mkzRKTh">Episode 2 - Thibaut aka theDesignIconoclast</a></p><p>Learn more about Thibaut and what he's contributed to Unlock re: the integration with ENS that enables new levels of decentralized onchain naming for Unlock contracts.</p><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.youtube.com/live/mjMMtUlctOQ?si=udDGEYqrc0lbQI42">Episode 3 - Paul &amp; the PGP (Pretty Good Privacy) for Crypto Community</a></p><p>Check out this episode to see an advanced implementation of Unlock that showcases the protocol's potential beyond the entry-level use we are most familiar with.</p><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.youtube.com/live/lgVNM-K6X6s?si=UARqg2ynk25ey_ZK">Episode 4 - G2 from Creative DAO</a></p><p>Catch up with G2 and learn how he is using AI and decentralized onchain primitives like Unlock to help bring music artistry into the next generation in a way that empowers and inspires human creativity.</p><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.youtube.com/live/TvOqTVMOuV8?si=t-LlyqCRXNMdJDSE">Episode 5 - Our very own Julien Genestoux</a></p><p>Don't miss a chance to hear from the longest-standing locksmith in Unlock and gather insights from the man who's been behind the scenes since day 1.</p><p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://www.youtube.com/live/Z0EIyjVCi5g?si=0-eZ5b91XLHVxpat">Episode 6 - WillT (final episode of season 1)</a></p><p>Find out what the legendary WillT is up to and how he has been building with Unlock for longer than almost anyone in the community, plus some secret tips from a master of productivity to help you streamline your workflows.</p><p><em>These episodes are not only interesting and entertaining, but they are shining examples of why Unlock exists and what it enables for other projects. The more we share these stories, the sooner other projects will learn how to use Unlock to achieve their own community goals.</em></p><hr><h3 id="h-the-slow-shift-to-telegram" class="text-2xl font-header !mt-6 !mb-4 first:!mt-0 first:!mb-0">The Slow Shift to Telegram</h3><p>The demise of Discord seems somewhat inevitable. It is a lot of overhead to manage a Discord server, and the days of thousands of daily active users in DAO Discords are gone. As the contribution circle tightens around the DAO's active core, many have found themselves most active on Telegram rather than Discord. This is a signal, one that needs to be acknowledged.</p><p>As such, the Steward team has migrated entirely to Telegram. We will keep the Discord open and updated as best we can, but if you want to engage in a more regular contribution cycle, <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc" class="dont-break-out" href="https://t.me/+HYCVY2wvXbs3Yjhi">Telegram </a>is the place to be.</p><p>Make sure to join us and share your feedback on all topics from this month's newsletter, and bring up topics you'd like to see more attention on!</p><hr><div data-type="x402Embed"></div><p>Thanks for following along, fellow locksmiths, and always remember:</p><h3
